findings.title: Separate allowed teacher Stage1-to-Stage2 diagnosis from forbidden student features
findings.impact: Literal negative acceptance rule would reject legitimate frozen Stage2 input or change the teacher treatment.
findings.minimum_fix: Split student and teacher input rules; preserve same-S5 Stage1 diagnosis/subgoal/validity path to Stage2 including existing invalid-Stage1 diagnostic generation; reject future outcomes and hidden states.

publication: Coordinator-owned; no shared index/inventory or independent commit/push.
